tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform, then select that Xcode in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools.

tools.name: /bin/bash
tools.label: Brawler build Python + Pillow
version_args:
PYTHON_EXECUTABLE="$BRAWLERPAD_PYTHON"
if [ -z "$PYTHON_EXECUTABLE" ]; then
    PYTHON_PREFIX="$(brew --prefix python@3.11 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$PYTHON_PREFIX" ] && [ -x "$PYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3.11" ]; then
        PYTHON_EXECUTABLE="$PYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3.11"
    else
        PYTHON_EXECUTABLE="$(command -v python3.11 || true)"
    fi
fi
if [ -z "$PYTHON_EXECUTABLE" ]; then
    exit 1
fi
if ! "$PYTHON_EXECUTABLE" -c 'from PIL import Image' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$PYTHON_EXECUTABLE"
tools.note: Brawler selects BRAWLERPAD_PYTHON first, then Homebrew python@3.11, then python3.11 on PATH. Install Python if none is available (for example: brew install python@3.11), and install Pillow into the selected interpreter with its -m pip install Pillow. For a virtual environment, use its Python without --user.
